AzureAd.// ClientCredentials: How this API proves ITS OWN identity to Entra for the on-behalf-of exchange that turns a caller's token into a Graph token for that same user (Teams channel lookup, Outlook reminders). Set up by IT Security 2026-09-17, DEV ONLY: a federated identity credential on the 'Origination API - Dev' registration (ClientId in the base file) bound to the app-origination-dev-eus SYSTEM-ASSIGNED managed identity, token-exchange audience api://AzureADTokenExchange. No secret anywhere — the App Service signs an assertion with its own identity. ManagedIdentityClientId is deliberately omitted (system-assigned). QA and Production have no credential yet by design; their feature flags are off. Only works ON the App Service: there is no managed identity on a laptop, so locally the Graph calls degrade to empty/no-op and the features stay dormant.

ConnectionStrings.// ODSDpConnection: Intentionally absent. DP contracts read ODSConnection above (Dev ODS), exactly like every other ODS query — no cross-environment override anywhere. The DP Contracts tab stays empty in Dev until ODS loads ctrm.vw_GNTA70D1; that is a data gap, not a config gap, and needs no code or config change when the data arrives. Do not add an override pointing at another environment's ODS: it would also require IT/DBA to grant this app's managed identity read access there, which is deliberately not in place.

AppAccess.// GroupId: Deployed Dev reads the DEV access group. Active — the app-origination-dev-eus managed identity has the scoped-group read + User.ReadBasic.All grant (2026-07-28), so usage-dashboard filtering is live here.
